The season began on 24 February and ended on 17 December 2023,{{cite web|url=https://www.eluniverso.com/deportes/campeonato-ecuatoriano/liga-pro-serie-a-se-jugara-a-partir-del-24-de-febrero-y-la-b-iniciara-el-14-de-marzo-nota/|title=LigaPro: serie A se jugará a partir del 24 de febrero y la B comenzará el 14 de marzo|trans-title=LigaPro: Serie A will be played from 24 February and the ''B'' will start on 14 March|language=es|publisher=[[El Universo]]|date=6 January 2023|access-date=8 January 2023}} with the fixture for the season being unveiled on 24 January 2023.{{cite web|url=https://www.ole.com.ar/ecuador/liga-pro/ligapro-calendario-2023-fixture_0_xaPsZcMCYs.html|title=¡Hay calendario! La LigaPro oficializó su fixture para el 2023|trans-title=There is a schedule! Quito|LDU Quito]] were the champions, winning their twelfth domestic league title after beating [[C.S.D. Independiente del Valle|Independiente del Valle]] on penalty kicks in the finals after a 1–1 draw on aggregate.{{cite web|url=https://www.eluniverso.com/deportes/campeonato-ecuatoriano/en-vivo-liga-de-quito-vs-independiente-del-valle-en-la-gran-final-de-la-liga-pro-nota/|title=¡Una estrella más! Aucas|Aucas]] were the defending champions. ==Teams== 16 teams competed in the season. [[C.S.D. Macará|Macará]] and [[9 de Octubre F.C.|9 de Octubre]] were relegated after finishing in the bottom two places of the aggregate table of the previous season, being replaced by the [[2022 Ecuadorian Serie B|2022 Serie B]] champions [[C.D. El Nacional|El Nacional]] and third place [[Libertad F.C. (Ecuador)|Libertad]]. El Nacional clinched promotion to the top flight with two matches to go after defeating Libertad 4–2 on 20 October 2022,{{cite web |url=https://www.eluniverso.com/deportes/campeonato-ecuatoriano/el-nacional-vuelve-a-la-serie-a-triunfo-4-2-ante-libertad-fc-asegura-el-ascenso-nota/ |title=¡El Nacional vuelve a la serie A!: triunfo 4-2 ante Libertad FC asegura el ascenso |trans-title=El Nacional are back to Serie A! 4–2 win against Libertad FC clinches promotion |publisher=El Universo |language=es |date=20 October 2022 |access-date=18 November 2022}} whilst Libertad themselves ensured promotion in the last round played on 30 October 2022, with a 2–0 victory over Imbabura and a 1–1 draw for América de Quito against Independiente Juniors. Despite having finished in third place in Serie B, Libertad were promoted to the top flight since runners-up Independiente Juniors are [[C.S.D. Independiente del Valle|Independiente del Valle]]'s reserve team.{{cite web |url=https://www.aficioncentral.com/noticias/futbol-ecuatoriano/libertad-fc-derrota-al-imbabura-sc-y-consigue-el-ascenso-so%C3%B1ado-a-la-serie-a/28921/ |title=Libertad FC derrota al Imbabura SC y consigue el ascenso soñado a la Serie A |trans-title=Libertad FC defeat Imbabura SC and get the dreamed promotion to Serie A |publisher=Afición Central |language=es |date=30 October 2022 |access-date=18 November 2022}} El Nacional returned to Serie A after two seasons, and Libertad will compete in Serie A for the first time ever. ===Stadia and locations=== {{location map+ |Ecuador |float=right |width=425 |caption=Locations of the 2023 Serie A clubs. |places= {{location map~ |Ecuador |lat=-0.278724 |long=-78.546433 |label=
